name: Xiaomi Redmi Smart TV A Pro 55" 2025 Energy-saving (MiTV-ASTR0, blueplanet, Amlogic), China firmware OS3.0.106.0.USTAATV, 3 GB RAM
warnings: Notes from this firmware: - The standby/screensaver ads come from com.xiaomi.mitv.hyper.screensaver: a plain Activity with its own downloaded carousel, not a DreamService, so screensaver_enabled=0 does not touch it. com.mitv.screensaver / com.xiaomi.mitv.advertise do not exist here. - Keep com.xiaomi.mitv.smartpanel enabled (Menu-button panel: source switcher + wireless tiles).

Do NOT add it here; disabling it kills the Menu key. - ADB over TCP closes on every boot: Settings -> 账号与安全 -> ADB 调试. - No idle clock screensaver is possible: the idle timeout path is a hard panel-off (suspend), the AOSP dream never renders.
